title: Pointless Doc Comments on Private Helper Routines
pattern: Documentation comments (`///` or `/**`) placed on private, internal functions that simply restate the function's name and arguments.
why_bad: Adds visual noise and documentation maintenance debt to internal utilities that are never exposed as part of a public API.
detection: Doc comments on non-public (internal/private) items that merely repeat the signature in sentence form.
counterexample: Doc comments on public APIs (`pub` structures or traits) where documentation is rendered as HTML.
fix: Delete the doc comment, or convert to a simple internal comment if a complex invariant must be noted.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4 ("Comments - Javadocs in Nonpublic Code"), p. 71; Trevor Foucher & Dustin Boswell, *The Art of Readable Code* (2012), Chapter 5, p. 48.
